name: r_zl_physical_light_repair_city042_mcw
description: Disposable, zero-credit native regression run for the physical-light gun-mod traversal repair. It installs the sealed city-start fixture unchanged, advances one player-selected native turn, and proves only that this repaired executable remains alive through the source-indexing path.

steps.label: settle_repair_fixture
steps.expected_visible_fact: the sealed city-start save loads in the current executable before the diagnostic action

steps.label: advance_one_native_turn_for_light_index
steps.objective: From the native World owner, make exactly one advertised movement or ordinary action that advances a turn. Confirm the process remains live and the World owner returns. This is a crash-regression diagnostic only, never an integrated-play account.
proof_targets: one native turn advances through physical-light source indexing without SIGSEGV
returned World owner after the action
invariants: no more than one turn-advancing player action

steps.label: save_and_exit_repair_diagnostic
steps.objective: Use native save-and-quit, then native Main-menu Quit and confirmation.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the diagnostic copy saves, returns to the main menu, and its owned process exits

evidence_contract.claim: this run can establish only that the repaired current-source executable survives one native turn from the preserved fixture; it supplies zero integrated-play, ecology, stalker-timing, or gameplay credit
evidence_contract.writeback_note: the fixture and every observation are repair diagnostics, not a new gameplay account
